title: CI exact PR-head recovery provenance and pull-request stale-run cancellation

phases.objective: Bind Recovery execution and test evidence to the exact current pull-request head, including manual recovery after bot-generated commits whose normal PR workflows are blocked before job creation, while cancelling only superseded pull-request CI runs and keeping workflow-dispatch verification non-cancellable.

e2e_journeys.actor: CI evidence publisher and repository reviewer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: CI Pull Request Recovery through pull_request or workflow_dispatch with pull_request_number, candidate_sha, expected_base_ref and optional expected_base_sha
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Recovery resolves the live open PR, proves the requested candidate is still its exact same-repository head on the expected base, checks out only that verified SHA, re-verifies currentness before tests, and publishes test/runtime evidence for that SHA without mutating the candidate branch or relying on an unrelated workflow-ref github.sha.
steps: For manual recovery, require pull_request_number, candidate_sha and expected_base_ref; accept expected_base_sha as an optional additional freshness constraint.
Load the current pull request through the GitHub API before checkout.
Require the pull request to remain open and its head repository to equal the current repository.
Require candidate_sha to equal the pull request's current head SHA and require the base ref to equal the expected base.
When expected_base_sha is supplied, require it to equal the pull request's current base SHA.
Expose the verified pull request number, candidate SHA, head ref, base ref and base SHA as job outputs.
Checkout the API-verified candidate SHA and reject any git rev-parse HEAD mismatch.
Before Unit & Integration execution, query the pull request again and reject a head/base change that occurred after syntax verification.
Scope context-kernel differential checks from the verified PR base SHA rather than an unrelated manual-dispatch workflow ref.
Run npm test with process-local GITHUB_SHA bound to the verified checked-out SHA.
Bind deployment/runtime evidence to the verified PR head ref and candidate SHA.
Use the pull-request event predicate as the only cancel-in-progress authority; manual recovery remains non-cancellable.
Upload ordered test progress reports without relabeling head execution as a different merge or workflow-ref candidate.
assertions: Manual recovery cannot silently fall back to github.sha or the workflow ref as candidate identity.
A stale candidate SHA fails before checkout and tests.
A candidate from another pull request, fork repository, wrong base ref or closed pull request fails closed.
A pull-request head/base change between syntax and test jobs fails before test evidence is published.
Recovery reports cannot inherit a different event-level GITHUB_SHA after exact-head checkout.
Superseded pull-request runs are cancellable while workflow-dispatch recovery is not unconditionally cancellable.
Recovery adds only read access to pull-request metadata in addition to read-only repository contents.
No empty commit, Draft/Ready toggle, repository write, protected-ref mutation, provider call, deployment, database action, migration, credential access, force push or external send is introduced.

phases.objective: Publish the verified pull-request/head/base identity and blocked-trigger recovery reason as explicit typed fields across all CI evidence families.
Prove identity preservation and current-head rejection across manual reruns, bot-generated writer commits, pull-request synchronize events, base advancement, and cancelled/restarted jobs.
This CI evidence and scheduling correction has no provider canary authority.
This CI evidence and scheduling correction grants no Production or deployment authority.
